topic.title: Talk Selection Screen
topic.shortdesc: The Talk Selection Screen is the first screen you see when you launch . From here you can log in, join an existing talk, or create a new one.

ol.li: Select the talk you want to enter.
Specify credentials if you are logging in for the first time.

dlentry.dd: Choose an existing, on-going talk from the drop-down list, or type a new name to create a fresh talk. Public talks are listed automatically; private talks require an invitation link.
Enter your registered email address. This field is pre-filled on subsequent logins if Remember me is checked.
Enter your account password. Click the eye icon to toggle password visibility.
When checked, your credentials are securely stored so you do not need to re-enter them on the next launch.
Authenticates your credentials and opens the selected talk in the Main Talk Screen.
Opens the account registration form for new users.
Initiates the password reset workflow. See for details.
